source.description: Nine cash-excess alpha estimates and mean-excess statistics on the original calendars, alongside their unchanged raw-return estimates.

metricDefinitions.label: Cash benchmark comparison
metricDefinitions.definition: Cash factor regression subtracts c from strategy daily return and every coin factor, retaining the intercept and original sample. Alpha annualization is365 times arithmetic daily intercept, not CAGR. Joint/matched BTC use calendarHAC27 with n/(n-k); full-calendar BTC uses HAC7 without correction. HAC27 t tests mean arithmetic daily excess; new Holm27 is across all nine strategies and three periods, separate from original acceptance.

evidenceFlow.title: Audited fixed-strategy cash benchmark calculation
evidenceFlow.detail: Read results/cash_excess/strategy_summary.csv, results/cash_excess/mean_excess_inference.csv, results/cash_excess/methods.json; filter period=development; retain every approved strategy in fixed ID order. Computed from saved daily returns and factor inputs without new hourly prices, trading simulation or selection.

limitations: Hypothetical constant USDT cash proxy, not an actual instrument or earned strategy interest. USD interpretation assumes USDT/USD parity.
Conditional diagnostics, not adjusted for the original basket/configuration/selection research and not a new independent test.

methods.code: Read the listed saved CSV/JSON results; filter this exact period. Display-only percentage/CI rounding; do not regenerate signals, targets, trades, coefficients, bootstrap draws or strategy selections.
